result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Contractor defends and indemnifies Company and its affiliates against third-party IP, legal-compliance, Contractor-caused data-security, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims; includes notice, defense control, settlement protection, and cooperation; and limits Company's indemnity to Company-furnished materials/content and breach of law. The uncapped carve-out is consistent with the preferred position, with the 3× cap being only the fallback. However, the existing IP warranty is unnecessarily relocated ahead of Section 7 and remains labeled subsection (c), creating a stray/duplicative subsection designation. The margin comment also incorrectly refers to Section 5(c). These organizational errors prevent the revision from being minimal and fully polished, although unrelated liability provisions are substantively preserved.
